purpose: Inspect the customer card, New/dropdown or tooltip context, templates and required-field signals before any customer write gate.
epic: Master Data first controlled write gate
businessPurpose: Prepare the first customer master-data write gate with enough UI evidence for a beginner-friendly handbook and a reversible Smart Decision.

smartDecision.decision: Run a customer preflight, not a customer creation.
smartDecision.whyNow: Customer is the lowest-risk and most useful first master-data candidate after customer/vendor/item read-first evidence.
smartDecision.whyNotVendor: Vendor adds payment, bank and purchase-process dependencies.
smartDecision.whyNotItem: Item adds UOM, inventory, product posting, VAT product and costing dependencies, and U-ITEM-HW100 already exists.
smartDecision.risk: Business Central New/template routes can create a draft or force a save if handled blindly.
smartDecision.fallback: Stop with screenshots and no data write if the route cannot be inspected without creating or saving a record.

screenshotQaRequired: New/Neu button, dropdown or tooltip context
template dialog or customer-card route only if safely cancellable
acceptanceCriteria: The run confirms playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE before inspecting any UI.
The run captures more than one screenshot checkpoint, not only an end-state screenshot.
The run documents whether New/Neu exposes a dropdown, tooltip, template dialog or direct card route.
The run stops before any save/create/confirm action.
The result names required fields or clearly states why they could not be observed safely.
The result says what the screenshots prove and what they do not prove.
stopIf: A dialog would create or save a customer before the route is understood.
The template dialog cannot be cancelled safely.
Required fields are hidden and layout, FastTabs, FactBox, focus mode and Page Inspection have not been checked.
The route requires force clicks or coordinate clicks as the normal strategy.
Any Preview Posting, Posting, payment, API or document action appears in the path.
trainingImpact: Creates beginner-facing material for Customer List, New/Neu, customer card/template route and required-field awareness.
uatImpact: Prepares, but does not execute, the first customer master-data UAT setup step.
bookImpact: Supports a handbook section on how a customer record is started and which fields must be understood before saving.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: Customer, vendor and item/service contexts were observed read-only. Customer is the least dependent first write-gate candidate, but the UI route, template behavior and required fields are not proven.
nextStepDecision.reason: The next useful move is a no-save customer preflight with screenshot QA, not another broad read-only list proof and not a blind customer creation.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Needed before any customer create gate.
Only sensible if PWS-MD-004 proves a safe, cancellable route and required fields.
Parked until customer route and payment/bank boundary are clearer.
Parked until UOM, product posting, VAT product, inventory and costing dependencies are checked.

queueChangesMade: Selected PWS-MD-004 as the next concrete prewrite case.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It turns the screenshot-learning issue into a bounded UI-proof step and prevents a blind New/customer save.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not click through a template dialog if it creates or saves a customer.
Do not claim customer setup readiness from visible fields alone.
Do not create sales documents or posting evidence in this case.
requiredPreparation: Review PWS-MD-001 screenshots and reuse the multi-checkpoint screenshot QA pattern.
